interpretation_rules: A gravestone-derived death date is not a verified burial date.
G.R.1 means a cemetery source code defined by each book; it is not manuscript volume 1.
Different web transcriptions of one book are not independent historical witnesses.
An observed page numeral in text is not visual verification of a printed page or original manuscript.
Journal p.179 is an additional observed locator for Dewey; standalone-reprint p.3 remains inferred.
Preserve in-his-78th-year wording separately from 78 completed years.
Do not assign an identity or relationship to the unknown person in QVMZ-BNWJ from a Joseph Perry name match.
External candidate dates do not change the seven undated frozen citations or other date classes.
The Thomas Temple Rockwood necrology gives 11 October 1872; preserve its conflict with the frozen 3 October 1872. A repeat in the same journal volume is not an independent witness.
